GAN-08: burying the viral video within 48 hours (Intelligence + Technology, Difficulty 5): the Thermometer doesn't rise

obtencion.como: Ezra's prelude: at 2:52 he sees a block of Gale Sentinel cameras in Ballard go dark for eleven minutes.
Intelligence + Technology (Difficulty 3): Helen's camera has a disconnection log from 2:52 to 3:03.

The thieves were mortal professionals and the cameras were looped. Intelligence + Investigation (Difficulty 3) when searching the apartment: they got in with an electronic lock pick and knew where to look (P-01, reinforced); with 3 or more successes, the adhesive repeater on the door frame.
DOC-01: the cameras that “didn't record anything” are the first sign of Gale Sentinel.
The dark lights on the Gale Sentinel cameras are P-01 and lead to A1-E05.

Resolve + Awareness (Difficulty 2), or automatic with Auspex 1: the coin smell in the hallway is watered-down Vitae, with no Beast behind it. Auspex 4 (Spirit's Touch) on the doorknob: the mark of a ghoul waiting for their next dose.
Smell of someone else's Vitae on the doorknob: it belongs to a ghoul (if it wasn't found earlier).
The one sniffing around the stairwell is a Gale ghoul (MEN-04). His Vitae is the P-02 trail.

Intelligence + Brawl (Difficulty 4): dents at chest height, always in the same sequence (ribs, sternum, throat). If a PC shows David the dents and asks him what he sees, the clue comes out without a roll (LOR-01 at level 4).
LOR-01 level 4 “The Full Guard”: you recognize the doctrine the moment you see it.

efectos.efecto: Vote: Thornquist switches to “no” if the coterie proves to him that Krell, Halloway's man, destroyed Pike (P-03 plus P-12 or Krell's testimony).

Manipulation + Persuasion (Difficulty 4) with Thornquist: with one success he confirms there are copies for sale; with 3 or more, he reveals that Jun brought them to him and where she sleeps. Ezra gets +2 dice.
Intelligence + Technology (Difficulty 4) on Helen's laptop: the cloud was wiped from an IP at an Eastside data center (P-06, partial).
Intelligence + Investigation (Difficulty 3): a request dated November 9, at 4:12, for access to the Market Street building's network, with no contract, authorized by “P.G.”
If A1-E05 is skipped, the same information turns up in A3-E02.
DOC-05: the November 9 message (“Change the lock”). It was Gale Sentinel (P-06).

If the coterie reaches David in time, he recognizes the inverted guard without a roll (LOR-01 at level 4); so does a PC with LOR-01 at level 4.
